observations: White dry iron on a tiled floor.
The power cord is visibly frayed and damaged near the plug and where it enters the iron body.
The exterior of the iron appears dirty and heavily used.
No brand name or model number is legible on the visible surfaces.

claims.evidence: Requires a video showing the indicator light and the iron heating up.

risks.risk: Electrical shock or fire hazard from frayed power cord
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the cord's condition or a video of it safely powered on.
Video of the iron heating up and evaporating a drop of water.

proof_requests: Video showing the iron plugged in, the indicator light turning on, and the plate getting hot.
Photo of the manufacturer's label/plate usually found on the heel or underside.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a generic dry iron. Due to the visible and severe damage to the power cord and the lack of proof of operation, it is priced at the worst-case scenario as a non-functional unit requiring repair.
